seasons.title: Winter Crappie Spots
seasons.subtitle: {count} public waters around The Woodlands and Lake Conroe where crappie are on the list.
seasons.label: Dec 1 – Feb 28

tips.text: Crappie keep feeding in cold water, so they are a good winter target when bass slow down.
Fish slowly: small jigs or minnows near brush, docks and deeper water.
The warmest hours of the day are often the best bite. Each spot's weather card shows live temperature, wind and pressure.

seasons.footnote: These are the spots in this guide that list crappie. Always check each spot's permits and posted rules.

seasons.title: White Bass Run
seasons.subtitle: {count} spots on and along Spring Creek where white bass are on the list.
seasons.label: Jan 15 – Mar 31

tips.text: In late winter, white bass leave the lakes and push up creeks to spawn. The run often starts in January or February.
Warming water and rising flow after a good rain are what set it off, so watch for a warm spell after rain.
Without a big rain the run can stretch out over one to two months, so keep checking.
Creek access is bank, wade or kayak. Check each spot's access and license rules before you go.

seasons.footnote: These are the spots in this guide that list white bass. Run timing changes every year with rain and water temperature.
